code:
M x V = P x Q

M = token supply in circulation
V = velocity (times a token changes hands/year)
P = price per unit transacted
Q = quantity of transactions/year

Token_value_needed = (P x Q) / V
caption: A rough quantity-theory framework, borrowed from monetary economics.

code:
Protocol processes $50,000,000/year in transaction volume

Low velocity (V=2, tokens held/staked):
  required market value = 50,000,000 / 2 = $25,000,000

High velocity (V=20, bought, used, sold immediately):
  required market value = 50,000,000 / 20 = $2,500,000
caption: Same usage, radically different implied token value -- V is the lever.

code:
Inflows:  Emissions         +3,000,000
          Vesting unlocks    +2,000,000
Outflows: Burns              -1,500,000
          New staking lockups -2,500,000

caption: The basic structure of a token model you could build in a spreadsheet.
